title: 4 Day Budget Kenya Safari: Masai Mara and Lake Nakuru
rank_math_title: Budget Kenya Safari: 4 Days, Masai Mara and Lake Nakuru
rank_math_desc: Budget Kenya safari for 4 days: two nights near the Masai Mara, a night by Lake Naivasha and a game drive in Lake Nakuru National Park.
post_content: This budget Kenya safari covers the Masai Mara and Lake Nakuru in four days without cutting the wildlife.
overview:
This budget Kenya safari covers the Masai Mara and Lake Nakuru in four days without cutting the wildlife. You stay in simple, comfortable tented camps: Enchoro Wildlife Camp near the Mara's Talek gate and Punda Milia Camp at Lake Naivasha. Game drives run in a 4x4 safari vehicle with a pop-up roof, shared with other travellers to keep the cost down. It suits backpackers, students and first-time visitors who want the Mara on a smaller budget.

Price: from USD 880 per adult sharing (low season estimate). Contact us for your exact dates.
highlights: Two nights near the Masai Mara with full-day game drives
Game drive in Lake Nakuru National Park for rhinos and flamingos
Simple tented camps instead of costly lodges
Shared 4x4 safari vehicle with pop-up roof

faq.q: How much does this budget Kenya safari cost?
faq.a: It starts from USD 880 per adult, based on low-season rates with a shared vehicle. A private vehicle costs more; ask us for a quote.

faq.q: Is a budget safari still good for wildlife?
faq.a: Yes. You visit the same parks and do the same game drives as on dearer trips; the savings come from simpler camps and sharing the vehicle.

faq.q: When is the best time to go?
faq.a: July to October for the migration in the Mara, or January to March for dry weather and lower prices.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Nairobi to the Masai Mara
itinerary.content: Morning pick-up in Nairobi and drive via the Great Rift Valley viewpoint to the Masai Mara. Afternoon game drive. Dinner and overnight at Enchoro Wildlife Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.content: Full day of game drives with a picnic lunch, looking for lions, elephants, cheetahs and big herds. Dinner and overnight at Enchoro Wildlife Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Lake Naivasha
itinerary.content: Morning game drive, then drive to Lake Naivasha. Optional boat ride. Dinner and overnight at Punda Milia Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to Nairobi
itinerary.content: Game drive in Lake Nakuru National Park for rhinos, buffaloes and birds, then drive back to Nairobi in the afternoon.

includes: Shared 4x4 safari vehicle with pop-up roof and English-speaking driver guide
Accommodation in tented camps on full board
Masai Mara and Lake Nakuru park fees
excludes: International flights, visa and travel insurance
Tips for guides and camp staff
Drinks unless stated, laundry and personal expenses
Optional activities not listed in the itinerary
